defect: spill-register state is assigned with blocking statements in a clocked process
rationale: The registered data state uses blocking assignment in an edge-triggered process, which can create simulation ordering differences and incorrect sequential synthesis intent.

mutation.description: Changed the data register updates in the spill-register clocked process from nonblocking to blocking assignments.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the spill register to its valid handshake and one-byte data storage.

labels.note: blocking assignment to state in clocked block
